title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Mickey Mouse?
description:
Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Mickey Mouse, through Spain's dictator and two American presidents.

Adolf Hitler → Francisco Franco → Gerald Ford → Ronald Reagan → Mickey Mouse

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Francisco Franco: In 1940, Hitler met Spain's dictator, Franco, at the French border.
   Photo, PD-US: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Hitler_and_Franco_at_Hendaye_(en.wiki).jpg
2. Francisco Franco → Gerald Ford: In 1975, Franco rode through Madrid beside President Gerald Ford.
   Photo by Karl Schumacher, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Gerald_R._Ford_and_Generalissimo_Francisco_Franco_Riding_in_a_Ceremonial_Parade_in_Madrid,_Spain_-_NARA_-_23869171.jpg
3. Gerald Ford → Ronald Reagan: In 1976, Ronald Reagan lost the nomination to Ford, then joined him onstage.
   Photo by William Fitz-Patrick, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1976_Republican_National_Convention.jpg
4. Ronald Reagan → Mickey Mouse: And in 1985, cold weather moved Reagan's inaugural parade to Epcot, with Mickey himself.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Ronald_Reagan_and_Nancy_Reagan_during_a_trip_to_Orlando,_Florida_and_a_visit_to_Epcot_Center_at_Disney_World_and_a_group_photograph_with_Mickey_Mouse_and_Minnie_Mouse_-_DPLA_-_5810c0c969617ab7f42e1b068ba08dca.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #mickeymouse #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
